delete.description:
Permanently delete an entire organisation.

Authorisation: caller must be the org owner. Refuses while the org has
an active Stripe subscription -- cancel via subscription settings first
so charges do not continue after the org is gone.

The cascade removes every member, team, project, task, comment, share
link and attachment in this org, plus any user (real or proxy) whose
only membership was this org. Real-user Supabase auth rows are
removed best-effort.

Returns `{"calling_user_deleted": bool}`. When true, the trigger user
themselves was cleaned up (their JWT is now stale); the frontend MUST
sign out before any further authenticated request, otherwise the
still-valid JWT will be re-provisioned into a phantom user row by
`get_or_provision_user`.

The destructive flow runs on an admin DB session (RLS bypass); the
authorisation check above uses the caller's RLS session.

get.description: List all members of an organization. User must be a member.

schema.title: Response List Organization Members Organizations  Org Id  Members Get

delete.description:
Permanently delete a user from this organisation.

Authorisation: caller must be the org owner. Refuses to delete the org
owner themselves (org-ownership transfer is a separate flow). Refuses if
the target still owns one or more shared (non-personal) teams; the caller
must transfer those first via /teams/{team_id}/transfer-ownership.

The destructive flow runs on an admin session (RLS bypass) because the
RLS policies on users/teams only let a user mutate their OWN rows; the
authorisation check above (which uses the caller's RLS session) is what
confines the elevated privilege to org owners only.

    413: File too large

Upload a file attachment using a JSON payload with base64-encoded content.

JSON-friendly counterpart to POST /attachments/upload. Use this from
clients that cannot send multipart/form-data (e.g., MCP). The
multipart endpoint remains the right choice for browser uploads —
base64 inflates payload size by ~33% and is unsuitable for large files.

Args:
    payload: Upload request with entity reference, file metadata, and
        standard base64-encoded content.
    current_user: Current authenticated user
    org_repo: Organization repository
    service: Attachment service

Returns:
    Attachment metadata

Raises:
    400: Invalid base64, invalid file, or validation error
    403: User has no organization
    413: File too large
